budget_items.what_was_recorded: The PEC amendment uses a mitigation fund of $51,406.00 to provide a premium holiday or premium reduction for subscribers enrolled as of June 30, 2013.
budget_items.quote: the town and the pec agree that the town, with the mitigation fund of $51,406.00, will provide a premium holiday or a one-deduction

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Individual subscribers receive a one-time payment of $88.60 and family subscribers $177.26, distributed this fiscal year, exhausting the fund.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel explained that individual subscribers would receive a one time payment of $88.60 and family subscribers would receive a one time payment of $177.26.

budget_items.topic: Legislative priorities: Special Education and Circuit Breaker
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Special Education costs for FY14 were $2.2m and the Circuit Breaker payment is $700k; Ms. Speidel asked that these be added to the Legislative Priorities list.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel added that the special education costs for fy14 in lunenburg were $2.2m and the circuit breaker payment is $700k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total acquisition cost for the Lane property (about 168 acres off Holman Street) is capped at $400k; a State grant at a 62% reimbursement rate is expected to fund the bulk.
budget_items.quote: total acquisition cost is capped at $400k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Purchase & Sale price of $3200 per acre, or appraised value if less, was negotiated.
budget_items.quote: they have negotiated a purchase & sale price of $3200 per acre or appraised value, or which ever is less

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY14 snow and ice appropriation is overspent; the DPW suspended the free sand and salt program; certified free cash is available in FY15.
budget_items.quote: appropriation for the current fiscal year is $250,500, to date we have expended $340,687, and we have another $120,712 of expenses which have not yet been incurred.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said there is certified free cash available in FY15 and proposed a placeholder on the warrant for a FY14 budget adjustment.
budget_items.quote: there is certified free cash that is available in fy15

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrants were listed in the minutes section; no vote on them is recorded.
The School Advisory Committee has discussed additional training costs.
The School Committee met and discussed budget line transfers.
budget_items.quote: met last week and discussed budget line transfers

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY15 budget includes restoring IT department hours that had been cut over the years.
budget_items.quote: to restore hours to the it department that had been cut over the years

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board members raised concerns about paying an engineer to review the engineer's plans, and that a peer review could create a debt.
budget_items.quote: if this is to be done then we would risk the possibility of establishing a debt

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Bertram wants to know how Park fees are collected and what they are used for.
budget_items.quote: ms. bertram spoke to say that she would like to know more about how the fees are collected and what the fees are used for.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The earth removal (about 50,000 cubic yards) is to be sold for a profit, which Ms. Bertram says makes it a true earth removal project.
budget_items.quote: is going to be sold for a profit which makes this a true eart emoval project
